about: Which ELCD 3.2 process replaces which BRANCH factor in the second database test. Fixed on 15 November 2026, before any run (experiments/record/PLAN_2026-11-15.md, B3).

pet_granulate_bottle_grade.process: Polyethylene terephthalate (PET) granulate, production mix, at plant, bottle grade

pet_granulate_amorphous.process: Polyethylene terephthalate (PET) granulate, production mix, at plant, amorphous

hdpe_granulate.process: Polyethylene high density granulate (PE-HD), production mix, at plant

ldpe_granulate.process: Polyethylene low density granulate (PE-LD), production mix, at plant

liquid_packaging_board.process: Liquid Packaging Board (LPB) production, production mix, at plant, production, mineral coated LPB (n=4), basis weight: 266 g/m2

glass_packaging_white.process: Container glass (delivered to the end user of the contained product, reuse rate: 7%), production mix at plant, technology mix
glass_packaging_white.note: one dataset for the three colours; 7% reuse inside the dataset

glass_packaging_green.process: Container glass (delivered to the end user of the contained product, reuse rate: 7%), production mix at plant, technology mix

glass_packaging_brown.process: Container glass (delivered to the end user of the contained product, reuse rate: 7%), production mix at plant, technology mix

electricity_mv_PT.process: Electricity Mix, consumption mix, at consumer, AC, 1kV - 60kV

electricity_mv_DE.process: Electricity Mix, consumption mix, at consumer, AC, 1kV - 60kV

heat_natural_gas_furnace.process: Process steam from natural gas 90%, consumption mix, at power plant, heat plant, MJ, 90 % efficiency
heat_natural_gas_furnace.note: steam at 90% efficiency instead of an industrial furnace

lorry_16_32t.process: Lorry transport, Euro 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 mix, 22 t total weight, 17,3t max payload

tap_water_RER.process: Drinking water, production mix, at plant, water purification treatment, from surface water

disposal_polyethylene_terephthalate_inci.process: Waste incineration of plastics (PET, PMMA, PC), at plant, average European waste-to-energy plant, without collection, transport and pre-treatment

disposal_polyethylene_incineration.process: Waste incineration of plastics (PE, PP, PS, PB), at plant, average European waste-to-energy plant, without collection, transport and pre-treatment

disposal_board_incineration.process: Waste incineration of paper fraction in municipal solid waste (MSW), at plant, average European waste-to-energy plant, without collection, transport and pre-treatment

disposal_glass_incineration.process: Waste incineration of glass/inert material, at plant, average European waste-to-energy plant, without collection, transport and pre-treatment

disposal_polyethylene_landfill.process: Landfill of plastic waste, at landfill site, landfill including landfill gas utilisation and leachate treatment and without collection, transport and   pre-treatment

disposal_plastics_mixture_landfill.process: Landfill of plastic waste, at landfill site, landfill including landfill gas utilisation and leachate treatment and without collection, transport and   pre-treatment

disposal_board_landfill.process: Landfill of paper waste, at landfill site, landfill including landfill gas utilisation and leachate treatment and without collection, transport and   pre-treatment

disposal_glass_landfill.process: Landfill of glass/inert waste, at landfill site, landfill including leachate treatment and without collection, transport and pre-treatment

why_gaps.aluminium_primary, aluminium_secondary_o: ELCD has aluminium sheet only as one data set that already joins primary production, rolling and recycling, so the recycled content cannot vary
why_gaps.disposal_aluminium_incineration, disposa: ELCD has incineration and landfill of ferro metals, not of aluminium
why_gaps.stretch_blow_moulding, injection_mouldin: ELCD has no plastic conversion processes
